summary: Radio Button control: one selectable option; place several inside a Radio Button Group, which reports the chosen value.
description: A Radio Button is one option in a mutually-exclusive set. Each carries a `value` parameter; the enclosing Radio Button Group enforces single selection among its child radio buttons and outputs the selected `value`. The button itself exposes `checked` (is this one selected) and the usual interaction/styling surface.
whenToUse: Small option sets where all choices should be visible at once. The group, not the individual buttons, is what logic listens to; without a Radio Button Group ancestor the buttons cannot coordinate exclusivity.

ports.checked: Boolean level; whether this particular option is the selected one.

runtimeBehavior: Declared-port-groups: label and per-visual-state styling ports appear per configuration, matching the other controls.
antiPatterns: Wiring logic to each radio button's `checked` — listen to the group's `value` instead.
